newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian stock market stagnates for second week.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian stock market stagnates for second week.

text.p: No corporate issues traded on Bulgarian bourses for a second week in a row as brokers shied away from company stocks due to the high risk, brokers said on Friday.
"Corporate paper is deemed high risk and low yield compared to treasury paper," said a broker.
Weekly repo turnover on local bourses rose to an all-time high of 26.5 million levs from 7.648 million levs last week.
The previous all-time high repo turnover was registered in the week to October 4.
The 13-share Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index (RABSI) closed at 41.28 points, unchanged from last Friday.
* RABSI calculated on daily basis since February 1, 1994
